text: Conflicting numbers to watch: VAT threshold €60,000 (government) vs €85,000 (PP) for 2027; deficit quoted as 3.5% cash vs 4.2% accrual (and €4.7bn in union commentary vs the bill's cash-basis framing); maternity €450 flat vs 70% of insured income; pension indexation given as a 7–8% band rather than a single figure.
